(vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo.description: (Vertigo) Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo is a type of dizziness caused by specific head movements.

AIDS.description: AIDS (Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome) is a disease caused by HIV that weakens the immune system.

Acne.description: Acne is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells.

Alcoholic hepatitis.description: Alcoholic hepatitis is inflammation of the liver due to alcohol consumption.

Allergy.description: Allergy is an immune system reaction to a substance in the environment.

Arthritis.description: Arthritis is inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness.

Bronchial Asthma.description: Bronchial Asthma is a respiratory condition characterized by inflammation of the airways.

Cervical spondylosis.description: Cervical spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the cervical spine.
precautions: Use heating pad or cold pack

Chicken pox.description: Chicken pox is a highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy rash.

Chronic cholestasis.description: Chronic cholestasis is a condition where bile flow from the liver is reduced for a prolonged period.

Common Cold.description: Common Cold is a viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.

Dengue.description: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing flu-like symptoms.

Diabetes.description: Diabetes is a chronic condition that affects how the body processes blood sugar.

Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles).description: Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles) is a condition characterized by swollen blood vessels in the rectum.

Drug Reaction.description: Drug Reaction occurs when the body reacts adversely to a medication.

Fungal infection.description: Fungal infection is a common skin condition caused by fungi.
precautions: Use detol or neem in bathing water

GERD.description: GERD (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease) is a digestive disorder that affects the lower esophageal sphincter.

Gastroenteritis.description: Gastroenteritis is an inflammation of the stomach and intestines, typically caused by a virus or bacteria.
precautions: Stop eating solid food for while
Try taking small sips of water

Heart attack.description: Heart attack is a sudden and severe reduction in blood flow to the heart muscle.

Hepatitis B.description: Hepatitis B is a viral infection that attacks the liver.

Hepatitis C.description: Hepatitis C is a viral infection that causes liver inflammation.

Hepatitis D.description: Hepatitis D is a serious liver disease caused by the hepatitis D virus.

Hepatitis E.description: Hepatitis E is a viral infection that causes liver inflammation.

Hypertension.description: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is a common cardiovascular condition.

Hyperthyroidism.description: Hyperthyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland produces too much thyroid hormone.

Hypoglycemia.description: Hypoglycemia is a condition characterized by abnormally low blood sugar levels.

Hypothyroidism.description: Hypothyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough thyroid hormone.

Impetigo.description: Impetigo is a highly contagious skin infection causing red sores that can break open.
precautions: Soak affected area in warm water
Remove scabs with wet compressed cloth

Jaundice.description: Jaundice is a yellow discoloration of the skin and eyes, often indicating liver problems.
precautions: Eat fruits and high fiberous food

Malaria.description: Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease affecting humans and other animals.

Migraine.description: Migraine is a type of headache that often involves severe pain and sensitivity to light and sound.

Osteoarthristis.description: Osteoarthristis is a degenerative joint disease that affects the cartilage in joints.

Paralysis (brain hemorrhage).description: Paralysis (brain hemorrhage) refers to the loss of muscle function due to bleeding in the brain.

Peptic ulcer diseae.description: Peptic ulcer disease involves sores that develop on the inner lining of the stomach and small intestine.

Pneumonia.description: Pneumonia is an inflammatory condition affecting the air sacs in the lungs.

Psoriasis.description: Psoriasis is a chronic skin condition characterized by red, itchy, and scaly patches.
precautions: Wash hands with warm soapy water

Tuberculosis.description: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that primarily affects the lungs.

Typhoid.description: Typhoid is a bacterial infection that can lead to a high fever and gastrointestinal symptoms.

Urinary tract infection.description: Urinary tract infection is an infection in any part of the urinary system.

Varicose veins.description: Varicose veins are enlarged, twisted veins that usually appear on the legs.
precautions: Lie down flat and raise the leg high
